tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Tee was out of stock. Overdue invoice 501 ($840) paid to unblock the vendor, 1 tee ordered ($8), arriving about 2026-09-05. Tauhid told 'out of stock', then 'on the way'.

agents.boss: Read the ticket's next step; sent Inventory and Customer Service; summed up the decisions for the owner.
agents.inventory: Found 0 in stock; proposed a 1-tee restock ($8); asked Accounting directly to request the blocking invoice.
agents.accounting: Requested payment of overdue invoice 501 ($840) after checking cash.
agents.customer_service: Sent two short messages (out of stock; on the way ~9/5) and closed the ticket.

human_approvals.for: Purchase order: 1 x Classic Bulldog Tee S (#101)

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.outcome: Rent of $2,400 for the Chapel Street shop paid before its 2026-09-02 due date; next due 2026-10-02. Landlord got two notes.

agents.boss: Sent Facilities; reported the rent decision.
agents.accounting: Confirmed directly to Facilities that cash covered rent alongside invoice 501.
agents.facilities: Checked the lease, asked Accounting about cash, requested rent, messaged the landlord, closed after payment.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Only 8 of 20 hoodies in stock. Owner rejected the $264 restock and said no to the 10% discount. Club got one message: 8 hoodies at $58 each ($464).

agents.boss: Sent Inventory and Customer Service; gave the owner two yes/no decisions.
agents.inventory: Found 8 in stock; proposed a 12-hoodie restock ($264); checked with Accounting directly.
agents.accounting: Reported that cash could not cover every bill if the restock were also paid.
agents.customer_service: Priced a 10% discount ($52.20) without telling the customer, then sent the one final message and closed.
